items.text: Lu kes isasedotin ka Ilebin luapotu kouparos ka Serubabel okoku loka Sealutiel, ka Yesua, Seraia, Yeremia, Esera;
Salu, Amok, Kilikia, Yedaia. Ŋul kes ijaka luka isasedotin ka luka ikeeeinacan kapaarasia nuka Yesua.
Ido Ilebin: Yesua, Binui, Kadumiel, Serebia, Yuda, ka Matania loapolokinit aimal, ŋes ka ikeinaean.
Bakabukia da ka Uno, iinacanakec, komeanakinos kakes korioneta.
Yesua kouri Yoiakim, Yoiakim kouri Eliasib, Eliasib kouri Yoiada,
Yoiada kouri Yonatan, Yonatan kouri Yadua.
Kapaarasia nuka Yoiakim ajaas isasedotin, ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee: loka Seraia, Meraia; loka Yeremia, Kanania;
loka Esera, Mesulam; loka Amaria, Yekokanan;
loka Maluki, Yonatan; loka Sebania, Yosep;
loka Karim, Aduna; loka Meraiot, Kelikai;
loka Ido, Sekaria; loka Gineton, Mesulam;
loka Abiya, Sikiri; loka Miniamin, loka Moadia, Pilitai;
loka Biliga, Samua; loka Semaia, Yekonatan;
loka Yoiarib, Matenai; loka Yedaia, Usi;
loka Salai, Kalai; loka Amok, Eber;
loka Kilikia, Kasabia; loka Yedaia, Netanel.
Ilebin kapaarasia nuka Eliasib, ka Yoiada, ka Yokanan, ka Yadua, aponi kiwadikai ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee, ka isasedotin da, kairum naka Dario Eperusiat.
Aponi kiwadikai odwe luka Lebi, ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakec oitabo loka aisiitonokin, aitodol apaarasia nuka Yokanan okoku loka Eliasib.
Ŋaka luka Ilebin: Kasabia, Serebia, ka Yesua okoku loka Kadumiel, ka iinaeanakec kosesenas, aiturit ka aimal kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka Daudi etuŋanan loka Edeke, erioŋet koseseni erioŋet.
Matania, ka Bakabukia, Obadia, Mesulam, Talumon, Akub, kes ikagolok luedarete aiŋadisia nukorutei.
Ŋul kes lukejaas kapaarasia nuka Yoiakim okoku loka Yesua, okoku loka Yosadak, kapaarasia da nuka Nekemia ekayaiton ka nuka Esera esasedoti ekewadikan.
Komoata kesi Ilebin kotoma aiboisiokec kere, ayaun kes Yerusalem atiakunio naka arwatat, aidar atiakunio kaiyalama, kimalaete, koyeete, kojaas kaisinin, ka isabulin, ka adeudeun.
Kotukonokinos odwe luka ikayook, anyoun kotoma apuuton nairimorit Yerusalem, koreria da luka Inetopatin;
kotoma Bet-giligal, komanikoria lukoGeba ka Asumabet: naarai adukitos ikayook ireria airimor Yerusalem.
Kitesegaaros isasedotin ka Ilebin, kitesegaasi ituŋa da, ka irutei ka arwatar.
Kasodi ketodoka lukapolok luka Yuda arwatat, kepiiki atukon aarei nucpolok nuimalaete ka nuelosete kokokoron; itorit atukot adiopet akan nakotcten karwatat abear orute loka aoret.
Kotupite kes Kosaia, ka atutubet naka ikapolok luka Yuda.
Ka Asaria, ka Esera, ka Mesulam,
Yuda, ka Benyamin, ka Semaia, ka Yeremia,
ka ice kodwe luka isasedotin ejaas karupepen: Sekaria okoku loka Yonatan, okoku loka Semaia, okoku loka Matania, okoku loka Mikaia, okoku loka Sakur, okoku loka Asap;
ka ikeinacan, Scmaia, ka Asarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nctanel, ka Yuda, ka Kanani, kojaas kiboro lueruos luka Daucli etuŋanan leka Edeke; kiŋarenikinite kes Esera ekewadikan:
kitoroto orute loka eeoa, itcnarito, kodokasi kadoketa nuka ere loka Daucli, neikiaror arwatat, kuju ketogo loka Daucli, kiton orute loka akipi ari nakokide.
Kolot atukot ace kanul kaluimalaete airiamakin kakes, katupit eoŋ da kes, ka atutubet naka ituŋa, karwatat, kokuju togo loeoja loka iupaa kiton arwatat naelal;

kuju kerute loka Epuraim, ka neejai erute Iomoion, ka neejai erute loka lukeeor, ka etogo loeoja loka Kananel, ka etogo da loeoja loka Kamea, kiton orute loka amerekekin: kobwaata kopalarito korute loka ikedarak.
Kobwaata atukon aarei kanul kaluimalaete kotogo loka Edeke, eoŋ da, ka atutubet naka ikayaitok kaeon:
ka isasedotin, Eliakim, Maaseia, Miniamin, Mikaia, Elioenai, Sekaria, ka Kanania da, ejaas karupepen;
ka Maaseia, ka Semaia, ka Eleasar, ka Usi, ka Yekokanan, ka Malikiya, ka Elam, ka Eser. Kosodete ikayook ayoore keporoto loepol, Yeserakia ŋes ekenarenonikec.
Koinakis asuban nuepolok kapaaran kaŋin, kiyalamas; naarai abu Edeke kisiyalamikinite kes kaiyalama naepol: kiyalamasi da aŋor ka idwe; kopupunoi da aiyalama naka Yerusalem kaneelwana.

Kapaaran kaŋin aponi koseunai ituŋa apolokin agolai nuka iboro luka akais nuipu, luka ainakineta nuikeitai, luka araito nugeet, ka luka lukitomoneta, atukonokin kwape ejaatar imanikoria lukoreria, akorakineta nuieorakinitai isasedotin ka Ilebin kokisila: naarai abu Yuda kiyalamikin kanuka isasedotin ka Ilebin luejaanakinete.
Koricito aijaanakin naka Edekekee, ka aijaanakin naka aitesegaario, eswamaenenete kwape kwaŋin ikayook ka ikagolok, kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka Daudi ka naka okokuke Solomon da.
Naarai kapaarasia nusek nuka Daudi ka Asap ajaenena ekenarenon loka ikayook, ka ikososinei luka aiturit ka aimal Edeke,

Ido kapaarasia nuka Serubabel, kapaarasia da nuka Nekemia, koinak Isirael kere akorakineta nuka ikayook ka ikagolok kwape ejaar eipud loka ŋinipaaran: kogitasi nuka Ilebin; ka Ilebin da kogitasi nuka odwe luka Aaron.
